verdict.rationale: Warp's docs describe a built-in agent that writes code, runs commands and iterates until a task is done. It works in a dedicated conversation view and supports follow-ups, prompt queueing, parallel conversations and control of interactive terminal apps. Community users confirm they use the AI features, though one Pro user reports recent random agent failures and stopping. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that delegated tasks complete reliably, given the reported agent failures.
